reviews.text: A wonderful first experience for my Pomeranian. He looks fantastic, all his knots are gone, and he's so soft! 😍 The team was patient with him, and I highly recommend them. A little bonus: I wish I could have stayed with him, as grooming is also a special time to bond with my sweet boy. Thank you! ❤️ …
I'm very happy with the grooming of my little Coton de Tulear. The cut was fantastic; I haven't seen her look so good in ages! The groomer was also very friendly and attentive.

A huge thank you to Maeva and Christelle for their exceptional work! They are remarkably professional, incredibly kind, and gentle with animals. Attentive, caring, and truly passionate, they immediately put you at ease. The results are always impeccable; I'm delighted every time! I wholeheartedly recommend them to all pet owners. 🐾❤️

I'm giving it one star because you can't give 0/5, but that's what it deserves. Paying €70 for a one-hour service where my dog ​​was simply shaved without even getting a bath is outrageous. No effort was made to untangle the knots or satisfy the customer. Usually, a proper, thorough grooming takes several hours to achieve a beautiful result. This was a rushed job: it's clean, but the final look is really not attractive. No effort at aesthetics, zero customer service. I won't be back.

Hello, our dog (a flat-coated breed) is probably not the best candidate, but the reception was icy. There was no solution for an anxious dog other than to grab her by force and drag her with a chain leash, and I was told I was too stressed, etc. My dog ​​struggled, and we couldn't finish the grooming. However, I still paid the quoted price without any offer to come back. In short, not suitable for an anxious dog. Very frustrating.

A massacre! I'm devastated... I came in this morning with a specific request and a photo! We discussed the details I wanted to keep, namely a little length on the body and a little on the ears.
None of my requests were respected, AND the cut is extremely poorly executed; nothing is right. No two lengths are even, some strands are longer than others, and there's a stepped effect around her face... nothing is straight, some paws are thicker than others. I had to make them redo several details on the spot, but the damage was done.
Despite my obvious dissatisfaction, no compensation was offered or even suggested.

I brought in a lovely dog ​​who just needed a trim. Apprentices don't let a Chinese Crested leave in this state; it's a shameful job that cost me €55! The photo of my request and how I got my dog ​​back are attached, and I want to emphasize that I have a very docile dog. She is very kind and lets herself be taken care of.
Terrible, my dog ​​came home with damaged paw pads, as mentioned in several reviews. The price was also excessive for the work done.

I am absolutely 100% satisfied. My little Lilly Rose looks beautiful—she's not easy to handle and bites—superb, professional work.

I highly recommend them. Thank you for everything, and see you soon for more treatments.
Absolutely useless. At this level, anyone can call themselves a groomer.
Thank you for your service (for my dog ​​Tess)! Superb welcome, a little treat at the end, exactly as I requested, which wasn't easy for my dog ​​who doesn't like grooming! I highly recommend!

I've had Schannel (my dog) groomed here every three months for the past three years, and I've never been disappointed. The groomer is always smiling and very pleasant.

I highly recommend them.

The manager is lovely.
My little dog is never stressed when she gets her nails trimmed; with me, it's a nightmare.
No harness to suspend a difficult-to-handle Angora cat with dreadlocks, so no visit due to lack of equipment. A shame.

Absolutely avoid this place! I went this morning to have my dog's nails trimmed. She cut one nail, the dog screamed, then she told me I was stressed. There was blood everywhere when the dog walked, and when I told her it was bleeding, she replied, "Yes, it's nothing, it's normal."

I usually go to 16 rue du château des rentiers; they are professional and there's never a drop of blood. I left without having my nails trimmed; it will have to wait until tomorrow. 16 rue du château des rentiers was closed today.

We booked an emergency appointment for our cat, who was completely covered in dreadlocks. The person on the phone was very efficient and found us an appointment quickly. The appointment went very well; the woman who did the trimming was gentle and patient with our cat and managed to remove everything without hurting him, even though he was a little agitated. I highly recommend them, and thank you again!
Very nice professional work
Avoid this dog! My cute, gentle little Coton de Tulear got his paw cut open and bled a lot. He can't stop licking it and he's in pain.

She's been taking care of my favorite for four years now, and I love it!

Maeva must recognize my favorite, Teddy the skateboarder!
😍 …

My dog ​​came out looking great and received a treat as a reward.
A job well done.
Good advice.
Pleasant welcome.

No hello, no smile, not a word, grooming a crying dog and the person taking care of it says "oh shit," we left without a word, and she still didn't say a word. RUN AWAY, AT LEAST FOR THAT DAY, AND AT THAT TIME.
I went to the grooming workshops for my Bernese Mountain Dog; the welcome was perfect and the result impeccable. We go back regularly.
Very satisfied with the grooming of my little Yorkshire. Thank you

Avoid at all costs!
The initial welcome was terrible, they did the opposite of what I asked, they don't know how to care for a cocker spaniel, and they charged €80 for a haircut – I've never seen anything like it! I'm furious.
Warm welcome - excellent service!!!

Fantastic!!!

The manager is lovely, professional, and genuinely loves her job and dogs.

And my queen is treated like royalty.

I go there with complete confidence.
